name: Disha Harmony Gardens
address: Doddagubbi Main Road, Kyalasanahalli, off Hennur–Bagalur Road, Byrathi/Hennur corridor, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Disha Harmony Gardens is a three-tower apartment community in the Hennur corridor, offering two- and three-bedroom homes. The developer describes 247 homes across 3.25 acres, with a substantial portion of the site left open and recreation centred on Club Harmony. Its planning emphasises shared outdoor areas, family amenities and a high proportion of corner apartments.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Disha Harmony Gardens

faqs.question: Where exactly is Disha Harmony Gardens located?
faqs.answer: Doddagubbi Main Road, Kyalasanahalli, off Hennur–Bagalur Road, Byrathi/Hennur corridor, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560077. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 2 BHK, 3 BHK. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 1250–1745 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹1.2 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: December 2027. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Futsal court, Multipurpose court, Children’s play area, Cricket practice pitch, Seating alcove, Aroma garden with swing lounge. 30+ developer-marketed multi-generational amenities. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: 3.25 acres with 247 homes and three towers B plus G plus 14 floor arrangement 76 percent land as open space reported by the developer. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
